## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Interval and bounds interfaces
//
// The two interfaces behind the one-dimensional spans of `intervals.types.plato` and the
// axis-aligned regions of `intervals.types.plato`. Their derived bodies live in
// `intervals.library.plato` and
// `intervals.library.plato`.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds (inclusive Min/Max; inverted
// Start>End / Min>Max is the empty encoding and the Union identity).

// A one-dimensional directed span from Start to End. Start may exceed End,
// which encodes a reversed interval.
interface IInterval<T>
    where T: IAdditive, T: IInterpolatable, T: IComparable
    inherits IValue
{
    Start(x: Self): T;
    End(x: Self): T;
}

// An axis-aligned bounding region between component-wise Min and Max corners
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box).
// TDelta is the displacement type between two corner points (the vector type of
// TPoint), so Extent/Diagonal can name the Max - Min delta. TPoint is also
// IInterpolatable, which is what lets Center and Lerp blend the two corners.
interface IBounds<TPoint, TDelta>
    where TPoint: IDifference<TDelta>, TPoint: IInterpolatable
    inherits IValue
{
    Min(x: Self): TPoint;
    Max(x: Self): TPoint;
}
```
